title: Joules-to-GDP: How Much Economic Value Do AI Systems Produce per Unit of Energy?
abstract: arXiv:2610.30858v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An AI system can produce more economically valuable work while delivering less value for the energy it consumes. We therefore ask: How much economic value does an AI system create per unit of energy consumed? We formalize economic value in two ways: (1) net dollar value, the output's dollar value minus AI-system execution cost, and (2) time saving, the expert's completion time minus the AI system's completion time. Dividing each by measured end-to-end energy yields Net Value per Joule (NVJ) and Time Saving per Joule (TSJ), reported in USD/MJ and hours/MJ. We study 220 public GDPval tasks across 44 occupations, serving five open-weight models locally and evaluating four accelerator types. First, the occupation groups where AI systems succeed most often, deliver the greatest dollar value, or save the most time do not necessarily provide the greatest economic return per joule. translated_title: 焦耳到GDP：AI系统每单位能源能产生多少经济价值？
translated_abstract: AI系统可以在产生更多具有经济价值的工作的同时，其消耗的能源所带来的价值却更低。因此我们提出这样的问题：AI系统每消耗一单位能源能创造多少经济价值？我们以两种方式对经济价值进行形式化：（1）净美元价值，即产出的美元价值减去AI系统的执行成本；（2）时间节省，即专家的完成时间减去AI系统的完成时间。将每项除以实测的端到端能耗，即可得到每焦耳净价值（NVJ）和每焦耳时间节省（TSJ），分别以美元/兆焦（USD/MJ）和小时/兆焦为单位报告。我们研究了涵盖44个职业的220个公开GDPval任务，在本地部署五个开放权重模型，并评估了四种加速器类型。首先，AI系统成功率最高、创造美元价值最多或节省时间最多的职业群体，并不一定能提供每焦耳最高的经济回报。例如，在测试的任务中，工程类工作（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“每焦耳净价值（NVJ）”和“每焦耳时间节省（TSJ）”两个新指标来衡量AI系统每消耗一单位能源所创造的经济价值，并发现AI表现最出色、创造价值或节省时间最多的职业领域并不一定带来最高的每焦耳经济回报。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Net Value per Joule (NVJ) and Time Saving per Joule (TSJ) metrics to quantify the economic value AI systems create per unit of energy, revealing that the occupations where AI succeeds most or saves the most time do not necessarily yield the highest economic return per joule.
